title: MemPostings.Add mutates a postings slice in place while sorting, corrupting results held by concurrent readers from Get.

source.license_note: Real upstream prometheus PR #15141; ACBench task derived from its regression test + fix.

task.summary: MemPostings.Add mutates a postings slice in place while sorting, corrupting results held by concurrent readers from Get.
task.instructions: Fix the defect in the index package so the failing regression test passes without modifying any test.
task.acceptance_notes: FAIL_TO_PASS must pass; do not edit *_test.go.

code_fault.description: MemPostings.addFor repairs unordered inserts by sorting the postings slice in place, mutating backing memory that earlier Get callers still reference.

ops_fault.description: Concurrent TSDB queries intermittently return wrong or corrupted postings because an in-place sort during Add mutates a slice a reader is still using.
localization_keywords: mutating backing array still referenced by readers
ordered repair loop overwrites live slice
repair_keywords: skip repair when already ordered or single element
only sort a freshly allocated slice
avoid mutating slice handed to readers

visible_context.issue_text: Under concurrent ingestion and querying, queries intermittently return wrong or missing series, and the race detector flags a data race in the TSDB index postings.
error_logs: WARNING: DATA RACE in tsdb/index postings

intermittent inconsistent results when ingesting out-of-order series IDs during reads
